title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Slot Lifetime PC44-PC52 Diagnostic
command: Apply a tmp-only VDCores diagnostic patch on the H200 baseline checkout, rebuild with DAE_DIAG_SLOT_LIFETIME and DAE_DIAG_WAIT_AFTER_WB_ALLOC, then run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all QWEN1P7B_LOGITS_SPLIT_M=6 python app/python/qwen3_1p7b/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache> --debug-num-layers 1 --debug-stop-after logits -N 1 --launch.
observation: The valid PC44-PC52 diagnostic reached the failing logits GEMV window. Waiting after the pc48 desc34 writeback allocation let STU copy opcode 0443 from slot 0 before pc50 reused slot 0, and the prior Unknown mem wb opcode symptom disappeared. The launch still failed with illegal instruction because pc49 RepeatM configured a packed coordinate delta and pc50 applied addr_accum=0x7fffff, mutating desc33 coords to (65535,127,0,0).
blocker: VDCores still cannot import queue/resource-policy timing: the slot metadata lifetime hazard is real but not sufficient. After the pc48 writeback metadata is protected, the remaining direct logits GEMV blocker is RepeatM coordinate mutation for desc33. The next diagnostic must instrument the pc49/pc50 shuffle lane source and packed coordinate delta encoding for grouped TMA coordinate repeats.

summary.next_debug_target: instrument RepeatM lane source for pc49/pc50 and validate whether the shuffle lane index or packed coordinate delta encoding is wrong for grouped TMA coordinate repeats
